## MMR Vaccination Coverage
```{css, echo=FALSE}
p{
font-size: 18px;
}
```

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE)
```

```{r}
# === Set Up ===
boundary <- params$boundary
school_data <- params$school_data
childcare_data <- params$childcare_data
selected_district <- params$selected_district
selected_county <- params$selected_county
point_type <- params$point_type
selected_location <- params$selected_location
district_data <- params$district_data
county_data <- params$county_data
grade_data <- params$grade_data
selected_school_id <- params$selected_school_id

# --- Data Selection ---

# Determine if selected_location is a school or child care

if (selected_school_id %in% school_data$mde_school_id && !selected_school_id %in% childcare_data$idsch) {
  school_id <- selected_school_id
  childcare_id <- NULL
} else {
  childcare_id <- selected_school_id
  school_id <- NULL
}

```

### `r if (!is.null(school_id) && is.null(childcare_id)) {(subset(school_data, mde_school_id == school_id, select = school_name) %>% sf::st_drop_geometry() )} else {(subset(childcare_data, idsch == childcare_id, select = daycare_name) %>% sf::st_drop_geometry() )}`

```{r}
# === Grade Level/Child Care Details ===

is_school <- school_id %in% school_data$mde_school_id
is_childcare <- childcare_id %in% childcare_data$idsch

if (!is.null(school_id)) {
  metrics <- get_facility_metrics(
    is_school = is_school,
    is_childcare = is_childcare,
    school_id = school_id,
    facility_data = school_data,
    county_data = county_data,
    district_data = district_data,
    grade_data = grade_data
  )
  
  summary_data <- tibble::tribble(
  ~Metric, ~Value,
  "School Type", metrics$school_type,
  "Total Enrollment", as.character(metrics$total_enrollment),
  "Schoolwide MMR Coverage", format_vax_pct(metrics$overall_cov),
  "  Partially Vaccinated / No Doses", format_vax_pct(metrics$partial_vax),
  "  Medical Exemption", format_vax_pct(metrics$med_exempt),
  "  Non-Medical Exemption", format_vax_pct(metrics$nonmed_exempt),
  paste0(metrics$county_name_school, " County MMR Coverage"), format_vax_pct(metrics$county_vax),
  paste0(metrics$district_name, " MMR Coverage"), format_vax_pct(metrics$district_vax),
  "District Home Languages", metrics$languages
)
  
  summary_data |> 
    gt() |> 
    cols_label(Metric = "", Value = "") |> 
    tab_header(title = md("**School Level Overview**")) |> 
    tab_style(
      style = list(
        cell_fill(color = "#003865"),
        cell_text(color = "white", weight = "bold")),
      locations = cells_title()) |> 
    tab_style(
      style = cell_text(indent = px(15)),
      locations = cells_body(
        columns = Metric,
        rows = Metric %in% c("  Partially Vaccinated / No Doses", "  Medical Exemption", "  Non-Medical Exemption")
      )
    ) |>
  tab_options(
    table.border.top.color       = "#88C5D3",
    table.border.top.width       = px(2),
    table.border.bottom.color    = "#88C5D3",
    table.border.bottom.width    = px(2),
    column_labels.border.bottom.color = "#88C5D3",
    column_labels.border.bottom.width = px(2),
    table_body.border.bottom.color    = "#88C5D3",
    table.font.size              = px(13),
    data_row.padding             = px(7),
    column_labels.padding        = px(8),
    table.background.color       = "#FFFFFF",
    footnotes.font.size          = px(11),
    row.striping.background_color = "#F7FBFC",
    row.striping.include_stub     = FALSE
  ) |> 
    opt_row_striping()

} else{
  
  metrics <- get_facility_metrics(
    is_school = is_school,
    is_childcare = is_childcare,
    school_id = childcare_id,
    facility_data = childcare_data,
    county_data = county_map_data,
  )
  
  summary_data <- tibble::tribble(
  ~Metric, ~Value,
  "Total Enrollment", ifelse(is.na(metrics$total), "N/A", as.character(metrics$total)),
  "Total Eligible", ifelse(is.na(metrics$total_elig), "N/A", as.character(metrics$total_elig)),
  "Child Care MMR Coverage", format_vax_pct(metrics$overall_cov),
  paste0(metrics$county_name_school, " County MMR Coverage"), format_vax_pct(metrics$county_vax))
  
  summary_data |> 
    gt() |> 
    cols_label(Metric = "", Value = "") |> 
    tab_header(title = md("**Child Care Level Overview**")) |> 
    tab_style(
      style = list(
        cell_fill(color = "#003865"),
        cell_text(color = "white", weight = "bold")),
      locations = cells_title()) |> 
  tab_options(
    table.border.top.color       = "#88C5D3",
    table.border.top.width       = px(2),
    table.border.bottom.color    = "#88C5D3",
    table.border.bottom.width    = px(2),
    column_labels.border.bottom.color = "#88C5D3",
    column_labels.border.bottom.width = px(2),
    table_body.border.bottom.color    = "#88C5D3",
    table.font.size              = px(13),
    data_row.padding             = px(7),
    column_labels.padding        = px(8),
    table.background.color       = "#FFFFFF",
    footnotes.font.size          = px(11),
    row.striping.background_color = "#F7FBFC",
    row.striping.include_stub     = FALSE
  ) |> 
    opt_row_striping()
  
}

```
